title: Memory fact
description: One long-term memory about the user (memories.json item). Never contains secrets (see intents domain memory_secret).

id.description: Stable id, unique per record type (10 lowercase hex chars from new records; any string accepted).

updated.description: Last change time (ISO). Sync: the newer 'updated' wins; ties -> the lexically greater 'device'.

device.description: Device that made the last change, e.g. 'windows-<hash>' or 'android-<hash>'.

deleted.description: Tombstone: true = deleted. Kept (not removed) so the deletion syncs.

text.description: Third-person statement, e.g. 'Prefers Slack over email'.

category.description: Unknown categories are stored as 'fact'. This enum is the single source of memory categories.

created.description: ISO 8601 local time, seconds precision, no offset (e.g. 2026-11-15T09:30:00).

source.description: explicit | chat | assistant | observed | onboarding | manual | ...

key.description: Stable key for facts that are replaced, not duplicated (e.g. start_time).

at.description: ISO 8601 local time, seconds precision, no offset (e.g. 2026-11-15T09:30:00).
